course_name_en: Fundamentals of Mechatronics and Systems Engineering
prerequisites: Recommended: Knowledge in Mathematics, Physics, Mechanics, and Electrical Engineering, as taught in the basic mechanical engineering courses.

learning_outcomes.text: Students know the typical application areas, questions, and methods from the fields of mechatronics and systems engineering.
They are able to create physical equivalent models and block diagrams based on simple tasks from various application areas of mechanical engineering and process engineering.
They are able to analyze these models in the time and frequency domain and systematically solve simple design tasks.

syllabus_topics: Mathematical description of dynamic systems with the Laplace transform
Transfer element, block diagram, and frequency response
assessment_rules: The allocation of credit points occurs when the module final examination is passed. The module is weighted by the number of its credit points (factor: 1).
